v8ThemeSupport.description:
When `true`, merges Mantine's `v8CssVariablesResolver` with AppBuilder CSS
variables (v8 `light` variant colors). Default in product theme: `false`.

stateProtection.description:
When `true`, installs a `beforeunload` handler that prompts before
closing/navigating away with unsaved parameter changes. Default in
product theme: `false` (opt-in, to avoid breaking existing configurators).

forceColorScheme.description: Force light or dark color scheme on `MantineProvider`.

iconUrl.description: Single favicon URL when `iconDarkUrl` / `iconLightUrl` are not both set.

withArrow.description: Show tooltip arrow (standard Mantine Tooltip) (Mantine default: `true`)

step.description:
The step size for rotation around the plane normal. The step is provided in degrees for easier configuration but will be converted to radians internally.
With this setting, it's possible to snap the rotation to specific increments.
Default is undefined (no snapping).

stepThreshold.description:
The threshold for snapping during rotation around the plane normal. With this setting, it's possible to define how close the rotation needs to be to a snap point for it to snap.
Default is undefined (no snapping threshold).

min.description:
The minimum allowed rotation angle around the plane normal. The angle is provided in degrees for easier configuration but will be converted to radians internally.
With this setting, it's possible to restrict the rotation to a certain range.
Default is undefined (no minimum angle).

max.description:
The maximum allowed rotation angle around the plane normal. The angle is provided in degrees for easier configuration but will be converted to radians internally.
With this setting, it's possible to restrict the rotation to a certain range.
Default is undefined (no maximum angle).

handleDistance.description:
Distance of the rotation handle above the top edge of the rectangle, expressed as a fraction of the rectangle's height.
Default is 0.25.

uniform.description:
If true, the RectangleTransform will maintain a uniform scale, meaning it will scale equally in all directions based on the average of the local x and y scales.
If false or undefined, the RectangleTransform will scale independently in the local x and y directions.
Default is false (non-uniform scaling).

uMin.description:
The minimum allowed length of the rectangle's sides during scaling.
With this settings, it's possible to restrict the scaling to a certain range.
Default is undefined (no minimum length).

uMax.description:
The maximum allowed length of the rectangle's sides during scaling.
With this settings, it's possible to restrict the scaling to a certain range.
Default is undefined (no maximum length).

vMin.description:
The minimum allowed length of the rectangle's sides during scaling.
With this settings, it's possible to restrict the scaling to a certain range.
Default is undefined (no minimum length).

vMax.description:
The maximum allowed length of the rectangle's sides during scaling.
With this settings, it's possible to restrict the scaling to a certain range.
Default is undefined (no maximum length).

step.description:
The step size for scaling in the local x and y directions. The step is provided in world units.
With this setting, it's possible to snap the scaling to specific increments.
Default is undefined (no snapping).

properties.name: avoidSingleComponentGroups
properties.description:
Set this to true to avoid groups containing a single parameter or export component.
In case this is not set or true, parameters and exports of groups with a single
component will be displayed without using an accordion.

properties.name: mergeAccordions
properties.description: Merge accordions of subsequent groups into one.

properties.name: pbSlider
properties.description: Bottom padding of Paper component wrapping slider components.

properties.name: identifyGroupsById
properties.description:
Set this to true to identify groups by id instead of name. If so,
multiple groups with the same name will be displayed as separate groups.

properties.name: accordionPaperProps
properties.description: Props for the Paper component wrapping each accordion.

properties.name: elementPaperProps
properties.description: Props for the Paper component wrapping each element inside the accordion.

properties.name: accordionProps
properties.description: Props for the Accordion component.

properties.name: accordionItemProps
properties.description: Props for the c.Item component.

properties.name: accordionControlProps
properties.description: Props for the Accordion.Control component.

properties.name: accordionPanelProps
properties.description: Props for the Accordion.Panel component.

properties.name: wrapperStackProps
properties.description: Props for the Stack component wrapping everything.

properties.name: elementStackProps
properties.description: Props for the Stack component wrapping the elements except the topSection.

properties.name: panelStackProps
properties.description: Props for the Stack component wrapping the elements inside accordion panels.

properties.name: showButtons
properties.description:
Whether to show the buttons or not.
If false, the buttons will never be rendered.
If true, the buttons will always be rendered.
If undefined, the buttons will be rendered if there are changes to accept or reject.

properties.name: includeImage
properties.description:
Optional flag to control whether an image of the scene shall be
included with the model state.

properties.name: image
properties.description:
Optional image to be included when creating the model state for the line item.
In case no image is provided here, a screenshot of the model will be used
if

properties.name: includeGltf
properties.description:
Optional flag to control whether a glTF export of the scene shall be
included with the model state.

properties.name: parameterNamesToInclude
properties.description: Names of parameters to include in the model state.

properties.name: parameterNamesToExclude
properties.description: Names of parameters to exclude from the model state.

properties.name: screenshotProps
properties.description:
Optional screenshot settings applied when capturing the preview image
automatically (i.e. when includeImage is true and no explicit
image is provided).

properties.name: successMessage
properties.description:
Optional success message shown after a model state has been created.
Supports the optional placeholder `{modelStateId}`.

properties.name: errorMessage
properties.description:
Optional error message shown when creating a model state fails.
Supports the optional placeholder `{modelStateId}` when available.
